body: -b Build 0102. Season 9 complete. Tyler discloses: ~1119 CE sea crossing, scholar heading to Fez, asked what Tyler had seen — Tyler had nothing. Went to Marrakech 1127 to start writing. Archive is externally directed: built to give to the next person who asks. Tyler shaped the entire season deliberately. Camera Op will search for the scholar. Season 10 pending. No new site (mechanism cannot record ships between places). Network unchanged: Cordoba 412ft / Toledo 191ft / Prague 144ft / Genoa 97ft. Apples #544 #546 #548.
title: S09E05 'The Fifteen Years' — Season 9 finale; Tyler discloses 15yr interval; archive origin confirmed: letter to stranger on ship, ~1119 CE
